title: Map Barcodes
description: Decode paired sequencing reads into plate rows, columns, and gRNA identities using a reproducible synthetic screen.
objectives: Load paired FASTQ reads and the three barcode reference tables.
Understand the target sequence, regular expression, offsets, output, and runtime categories.
Run a 4,800-read synthetic screen and locate its mapped combinations and quality-control output.
prerequisite: Know the read layout used to encode row, column, and gRNA barcodes, and prepare reference CSV files with name and sequence columns.

scenes.narration: Map Barcodes decodes sequencing reads into plate positions and guide identities. The console reports sample discovery, parser settings, read counts, batch progress, output paths, and failures.
scenes.speech_text: Map Barcodes decodes sequencing reads into plate positions and guide identities. The console reports sample discovery, parser settings, read counts, batch progress, output paths, and failures.

scenes.narration: The DNA button opens the live sequencing backdrop controls. For this tutorial, Visibility is set to 10 percent so the moving bases remain visible without competing with settings or console text.
scenes.speech_text: The D N A button opens the live sequencing backdrop controls. For this tutorial, Visibility is set to ten percent so the moving bases remain visible without competing with settings or console text.

scenes.speech_text: All settings reveals every category without changing values. The five categories separate inputs, references, parsing, outputs, and runtime reliability.

scenes.speech_text: Recipes saves the complete sequencing configuration under a name, reapplies it later, or imports and exports a reusable settings file.

scenes.narration: Sequencing Input selects the FASTQ folder and determines whether R1 and R2 are combined as a pair or one read direction is processed alone.
scenes.speech_text: Sequencing Input selects the fast cue folder and determines whether R one and R two are combined as a pair or one read direction is processed alone.

scenes.narration: Barcode References points to three CSV lookup tables: one for gRNA barcodes, one for plate rows, and one for plate columns. Each table needs name and sequence columns.
scenes.speech_text: Barcode References points to three C S V lookup tables: one for G R N A barcodes, one for plate rows, and one for plate columns. Each table needs name and sequence columns.

scenes.narration: Read Parsing anchors on a known target sequence, extracts a fixed window, and applies a regular expression with named columnID, gRNA, and rowID groups.
scenes.speech_text: Read Parsing anchors on a known target sequence, extracts a fixed window, and applies a regular expression with named column I D, G R N A, and row I D groups.

scenes.narration: Output and Storage controls optional HDF5 read storage, compression, and whether unmatched barcode names are retained as missing values. The summarized CSV outputs are always written.
scenes.speech_text: Output and Storage controls optional H D F five read storage, compression, and whether unmatched barcode names are retained as missing values. The summarized C S V outputs are always written.

scenes.narration: Runtime and Reliability sets reads per chunk, worker count, and test mode. Smaller chunks use less memory; test mode validates the first chunk before a large sequencing run.
scenes.speech_text: Runtime and Reliability sets reads per chunk, worker count, and test mode. Smaller chunks use less memory. Test mode validates the first chunk before a large sequencing run.

scenes.narration: This synthetic library uses a 26-base target, starts eight bases before that anchor, and extracts 89 bases. The regex then names the captured column, guide, and row sequences.
scenes.speech_text: This synthetic library uses a twenty six base target, starts eight bases before that anchor, and extracts eighty nine bases. The regular expression then names the captured column, guide, and row sequences.

scenes.narration: The tutorial folder contains 4,800 paired reads spread across 24 synthetic wells and 12 guide barcodes. Paired mode compares R1 with the reverse-complemented R2 consensus.
scenes.speech_text: The tutorial folder contains four thousand eight hundred paired reads spread across twenty four synthetic wells and twelve guide barcodes. Paired mode compares R one with the reverse complemented R two consensus.

scenes.narration: Run validates paths and references, discovers paired samples, counts reads, and starts chunked barcode mapping. Stop requests an orderly interruption.
scenes.speech_text: Run validates paths and references, discovers paired samples, counts reads, and starts chunked barcode mapping. Stop requests an orderly interruption.

scenes.narration: The progress indicator and console show the active sample and batch count. This demonstration processes five batches of 1,000 reads or fewer.
scenes.speech_text: The progress indicator and console show the active sample and batch count. This demonstration processes five batches of one thousand reads or fewer.

scenes.narration: The successful run writes unique_combinations.csv with row, column, guide, and count, plus qc.csv with mapping quality statistics. It also saves reproducible settings, a manifest, and a rerunnable macro.
scenes.speech_text: The successful run writes unique combinations dot C S V with row, column, guide, and count, plus Q C dot C S V with mapping quality statistics. It also saves reproducible settings, a manifest, and a rerunnable macro.
